conclusion: The append helper has an explicit pointer-derived capacity gate. For begin nonzero and unsigned computed size below computed capacity, it writes one four-byte source entry at end and advances end by four. A zero begin or computed size at least capacity delegates to 0x822D1150 at 0x822D113C with the descriptor, current end, source pointer, and stack-local address. Growth, allocation, failure, and lifetime remain unresolved beyond that exact edge.
